item.title: Court cancels ‘Business Royals’ trademark over risk of confusion with Rothmans Royals
item.description: The Civil Court, First Hall, has declared the Maltese registration of the ‘Business Royals’ tobacco trademark invalid, ruling that it takes unfair advantage of the long-standing reputation of the Rothmans Royals brand and risks confusing consumers

item.title: Construction work in part of Santa Venera following homes structural safety concerns
item.description: The precaution comes after residents close to a construction site were evacuated from their homes following reports of structural concerns

item.title: Navigating malta’s real-world office market in 2026
item.description: Malta’s 2026 office market blends prestige and practicality, with firms prioritising fully finished, high-quality spaces in prime coastal hubs while optimising efficiency and cost

item.title: The different types of bingo games that people can try online
item.description: Bingo has come a long way from the traditional hall experience. With its move online, the game now comes in a variety of formats that cater to different play styles, time commitments, and levels of excitement, giving players more choice than ever before.

item.title: Court finds 2018 fireworks law changes breached residents’ fair trial rights, awards €40,000
item.description: The court awarded €40,000 to claimants who challenged a permit issued against the State Advocate and officers of the St Mary Fireworks Club of Mosta

item.title: Prime Minister baptises 2026 as Maltas year of steel
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela says that government will launch the Maltavision 2050 in the coming days

item.title: Driver and motorcycle driver grievously injured in separate accidents
item.description: The accidents happened 15 minutes apart from each other in Siġġiewi and Burmarrad

item.title: Mqabba deputy mayor under fire again after implying Alex Borg is mentally ill
item.description: In a now-deleted comment reacting to an interview with PN leader Alex Borg, Jonathan Dingli told him to 'prepare himself for Ward 10'

item.title: Appeals court confirms five-year prison sentence for serial shop thief
item.description: The Court of Criminal Appeal has rejected an appeal by a man convicted of a series of thefts from confectionery shops and convenience stores, noting his failure to complete a drug rehabilitation programme

item.title: After breaking records in Australia, this football coach is coming home
item.description: After a decade of title-winning success in Perth, Ramon Falzon is ready to bring his trophy-forging standards back home to Malta
